description: Modular three-phase UPS: status and alarm bits, battery, input, bypass, output and parallel-system measurements, subfeed currents and life time data

sources.title: Modbus Register Map: Symmetra PX 250/500 kVA
sources.note: all 18 pages; revision history up to firmware sypx646

source: Schneider Electric / APC, Modbus Register Map: Symmetra PX 250/500 kVA, 990-3936G
notes: Register addresses are the absolute decimal addresses of the manual (Modicon 40001 is address 0). Function codes 3 and 4 read the same registers; Modbus RTU and Modbus TCP are supported.
Status and alarm registers are bit words, bit 0 is the least significant bit and reserved bits are left out. Bits are atomic within one register only.
Registers appear in the manual in groups: the columns of the printed table are offset by one line from the data point, and each value here was matched to its data point by name and unit.
Registers added by newer firmware (the manual's revision history lists them up to sypx646) are included. The manual gives no registers 46145 to 46166 for the second frame.
For the settings of the network card see the AP9635 User's Guide.

ups_mode.0: NMC cannot communicate with the UPS
ups_mode.5: Temporary bypass due to a fault

system_mode.1: UPS in normal or battery operation
system_mode.5: NMC establishing communication with the display
